categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Wallet' and modifies coin selection logic in src/wallet/spend.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where discarded output groups are counted twice during coin selection under `-avoidpartialspends` or `avoid_reuse`, potentially triggering spurious 'insufficient funds' errors. The PR description notes that positive-value groups failing eligibility checks were inserted twice into `discarded_groups`, causing `AutomaticCoinSelection` to subtract their value twice despite adequate confirmed funds.
